text:
maria_g: Heads up — webinar landing is live on staging. Need final X + LinkedIn post copies and 2 CTA variants by EOD so we can queue scheduling.

 tj: passing two draft copies now. also confirming asset thumbnails & speaker headshots.

 lex: Quick timing recs — X: 9:00am PT (primary) & 12:00pm PT (amplify). LinkedIn: 10:30am PT. Last quarter we saw better demo signups at 10:30.

 sam-prod: Do we have a seed CSV for enterprise accounts? I'll wire up routing to the AE queue once it's uploaded.

 maria_g: seed CSV uploaded to Drive: /Marketing/Webinar/seedlists/enterprise_q2.csv — use utm_source=x_social and utm_campaign=webinar_may24. Please use column "owner_email" for routing.

 tj: Copy A (short, X-friendly): "Join our free webinar on making inference predictable — 5/14. Demo, benchmarks, and a live Q&A. Save your spot: <https://redwood.ai/webinar|redwood.ai/webinar>"

 tj: Copy B (LinkedIn long): "How do teams make LLM inference reliable and cost-predictable in production? Join Redwood Inference on 5/14 for benchmarking insights, a live demo, and concrete playbooks you can apply today. Panel + live Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"

 sophie: CTA variants: 1) Register — Save Your Spot 2) See Benchmarks — Download Snapshot. Which should be primary for paid ads?

 lex: Primary CTA: Register. Secondary (in thread comments/ad creative): See Benchmarks.

 tj: Also adding short thread plan for X — 3 tweets: teaser (benchmark stat), hook (what we’ll cover), CTA (register). We should pin the registration link in replies.

 maria_g: Asset asks: final speaker bios (2), 1 1200x675 thumbnail, short 30s clip for retargeting. Can design deliver by 3pm?

 tj: I'll ping design. @sophie — can you confirm clip edit?

 sophie: Yep, editing now. ETA 2:45pm. Will post final to the webinar folder.

 sam-prod: Routing rules for inbound leads: 
- If owner_email matches an AE and they are online -> assign to AE queue via HubSpot owner property.
- Else -> route to SDR triage queue with tag "webinar-may24".
- For enterprise domain matches -> mark priority: high.

 maria_g: Good. Can we add a fallback: if no AE accepts within 30m, send Slack notification to #sales-sdr with lead link and copy template?

 sam-prod: yep — will add 30m webhook. Example followup template: "Thanks for registering — wanted to share the benchmark deck and see if you'd like a quick intro demo. Are mornings or afternoons better this week?"

 lex: Quick QA — are we gating the benchmark snapshot behind an email capture? If yes, ensure the download link uses the same utm_campaign and marks conversion in GA.

 maria_g: yes gated. Download flow submitted to product. Please ensure GA event "webinar_benchmark_dl" fires on download.

 ops-bot: scheduled post: platform=X time=2024-05-14T09:00:00-07:00 id=post_8821 status=queued :white_check_mark:

 tj: Thanks — will do a final pass on copy before 5pm. Anyone want to run a quick A/B headline test in the scheduler?

 sophie: Yes to headline test. Let's run A/B for 12pm X slot only (short copy vs emoji-led).

 maria_g: Perfect. After posts go live, we'll pull the first-hour engagement and conversion snapshot and compare to April benchmark (CTR delta target >= +10%). I'll post results to #marketing-reporting.

 lex: Noted. Also adding a tiny experiment: one thread with a benchmark stat as image vs plain text to see impressions uplift.

 tj: All right — I'll update the scheduler config and share the final CSV mapping for routing once done.

 maria_g: Great work team. Ping here if anything blocks.
